verdict.rationale: Terraform documents review gates an agent workflow can rely on. Apply prompts for approval before acting, and plans can be saved with -out and applied later after review. HCP Terraform adds policy enforcement (Sentinel/OPA/Terraform policy), and policy results can be overridden in the UI. The official MCP server exposes workspace run management to agents. However, nothing shows least-privilege or scoped credentials for an agent, and the approval prompt can be bypassed with -auto-approve. Missing for 10: documented least-privilege or scoped agent credentials, a documented agent-specific approval gate that cannot be bypassed, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent plan/apply under policy gates.
